images.title: Drawing an angle of a half turn and a 1/12 turn more
images.purpose: Show how to draw an angle for a 1/2 + 1/12 turn: lay a half turn and then a 1/12 piece from the given line and draw the second line along the last edge.
images.composition: A given line, a half-turn piece and a 1/12 piece laid after it, the second line along the last edge, and the sum written on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Corner point (560, 340) shown as a dark dot 26 px across. The given line is a teal #0072B2 line (10 px, 380 px long) going right from the corner along y 340, labelled given line (34 px, bold, dark) above its end at (800, 300). A half-turn piece: the upper half of a circle of radius 240 px centred on the corner (a semicircle above the given line), filled pale grey #6B7280 at 25 percent opacity with a thin dark outline, labelled 1/2 (44 px, bold, dark) inside at (560, 200). A 1/12 piece: a sector of radius 240 px that is one twelfth of a circle, laid next to the half-turn piece on the left side going down (it starts on the straight line that runs left from the corner and ends 30 steps lower, down and to the left), filled amber #E69F00 at 60 percent opacity with a thin dark outline, labelled 1/12 (36 px, bold, dark) beside it at (300, 410). The second line is a reddish purple #CC79A7 line (10 px, 380 px long) from the corner along the last edge of the amber piece, ending at about (231, 530), labelled second line (34 px, bold, dark) near its end at (180, 590). A red #D55E00 curved arc (4 px, radius 110 px, with an arrowhead) runs from the given line anti-clockwise over the top and down to the second line, marking the whole turn. RIGHT SIDE: four lines of dark bold text (46 px) left aligned at x 920: 1/2 + 1/12 at y 260, = 6/12 + 1/12 at y 340, = 7/12 at y 420, and, smaller (38 px) at y 500 and y 550, more than a / straight angle. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the 1/12 piece drawn wider than half of a 1/6 piece
more or fewer than 2 pieces laid
images.takeaway: A half turn and a 1/12 piece more make a 7/12 turn, which is more than a straight angle.
images.description: A given line with a half-turn piece and a 1/12 piece laid after it, the second line drawn along the last edge, and 1/2 + 1/12 = 7/12 written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Drawing an Angle. It follows the idea of drawing angles for given turns using the given lines in your maths book and shows the concept's own example of a 1/2 + 1/12 turn.
images.teaching_notes: Lay the pieces one after another and draw only along the last edge. The slip to watch is stopping at the half turn and forgetting the 1/12 piece.

image_decisions.why: The half-turn piece and the 1/12 piece laid one after the other show how to draw an angle for a sum of turns.
